text: Which of my repositories have uncommitted changes or commits that are not pushed yet? List each with what is pending.
Which of my repositories have failing CI according to the cached results? Write a short markdown report to {{scratch}}/ci.md with one line per failing repository, and tell me how many there are.
How many TODO items does each of my repositories have? Show me the ten with the most.
Summarize the policy lint findings across my repositories: how many findings per rule, and list the fixable ones that are errors.
Which repositories have had commits sitting unpushed for more than two weeks? Oldest first, with how many days.
Which of my forks are behind their upstream according to the cached comparison, and by how much?

For every repository whose checkout has uncommitted changes, write a JSON file into {{scratch}}/dirty/ named after the repository (replace / with _) holding its branch and counts of staged, unstaged, and untracked files.
Which repositories are checked out on a branch other than main or master, and since when have they been on it?
